Bid Summary: The bid is for the provision of student and staff computing devices, including laptops, tablets, desktops, and monitors. The district is seeking proposals from vendors to provide these devices, with a focus on meeting the minimum specifications detailed in the RFP. The contract will be governed by the terms and conditions outlined in the RFP, including the district's terms and conditions, attestations to certifications, and general requirements.
Product Specification: Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook Laptop: Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent, 11.6" diagonal display, 8GB DDR5 Memory, 64 GB eMMC, Chrome O/S License Required, 1-year minimum warranty. Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop: Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent, 14" diagonal Non-Touch display, 8GB DDR5 Memory, 128 GB eMMC, Chrome O/S License Required, 1-year minimum warranty. Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen or equivalent, 13" diagonal display, Enterprise Management Ready w/ Autopilot Enrollment. Devices must meet minimum requirements, including battery life, processor, and storage. Windows devices must have autopilot, and Chromebooks must have enrollment in Google Management.
